summary: The team is executing a seven-month SEO/AI-search visibility strategy with Asia Star and Intelligent China as top priorities, while finalizing the Knowledge website redesign and resolving an Outlook account lockout.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is the Outlook account lockout affecting the team; everyone must delete and re-login on all devices, update passwords, and confirm with IT/JSB that the backend is unlocked. The global marketing strategy is now focused on Asia Star and Intelligent China, with US partnerships on hold; Joseph needs to draft the target areas/prompts document and analyze Asia Star participant profiles and CRM hot leads, and the Intelligent China webpage must be launched and traffic driven to it. The Knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: Joseph will share the HTML concept, a 30-minute feedback session will be held, and Joker will make design changes; decisions include removing the standalone videos section, keeping the two-menu structure, and adding BCI/BSI index banners. Upcoming items include obtaining a detailed brief on Google Ads conversion tracking setup, and later tasks such as updating award status in the press release and changing the PRME platform password once fixed.
